title: Ethno feedback pulse and feature needleboard
executive_summary: Quick synthesis from 9 customer interviews, 14 support threads, and three live monitoring anomalies collected between 2027-03-15 and 2027-03-29. Pattern: customers surface a small set of operational pain points (cache controls, predictable fallbacks, per-route cost visibility) that map cleanly to low-effort probes and 2–3 medium-effort product bets. Goal: convert ethnographic signals into a needleboard of prioritized, testable feature probes for the next sprint.
methodology: Mixed: half-hour ethnographic interviews with engineering/product leads at 9 customers, ticket mining (support + SRE), and lightweight telemetry sampling (top 10 routes by QPS). Notes captured in quick snippets, then affinity-mapped into themes. Emphasis on operational reproducibility: each theme includes a customer vignette, measurable metric, proposed probe, and rollback criteria.
raw_snippets: "Client A" — 'We had a sudden surge and the model fallback kicked us to a 2x latency spike; hard to find why the request chose the fallback.'
"Client B" — 'KV cache TTLs are global and hurting our conversational cost; want per-route TTL so we can keep cheap prefixes warm for 2 routes only.'
"Client C" — 'Embedding refresh is a nightmare—no native delta-update so we reupload full index nightly; costs are getting silly.'
"Client D" — 'We'd like a token-cost breakdown tied to prompt templates, not just per-request average.'
"Client E" — 'Dedicated capacity is great but autoscaling knobs are too opaque; we want a predictive headroom slider.'
"Support thread #1892" — 'Observed repeated 502s during canary rollouts when KV cache warm-up overlapped with autoscale events.'
"SRE alert" — 'KV cache hit-rate drop correlates with a versioned rollout that changed prefix behavior.'
"Field note" — 'Customers doing heavy reranking/embeddings want batch endpoints with explicit cost caps.'
prioritized_feature_requests: Per-route KV cache policy: TTL and capacity knobs at route level (probe: add UI + API flag; metric: route-level cache hit-rate and cost delta).

Graceful-model-fallback transparency: expose routing decision trace for a request including fallback reason and chosen variant (probe: trace header + console view; metric: rollback frequency and mean latency under fallback).
Prompt-template token accounting: attribute token consumption and cost to named templates; surface top templates by cost (probe: add opt-in tagging + dashboard; metric: % cost attributed).
Delta-update embeddings API: allow partial upserts and deletes to embedding indexes (probe: beta API + client library sample; metric: time to effective refresh and ingestion cost).
Dedicated autoscale headroom control: UI slider and SLA preview showing expected latency at X headroom (probe: add slider + simulation; metric: missed-SLO events during spikes).
Batch endpoint with cost caps for reranking: server-side soft-cap and backpressure vs hard-reject (probe: add experimental endpoint; metric: throughput, latencies, and cost variance).
probe_plan: Week 0: instrument two customers for per-route cache telemetry and enable trace headers for routed fallbacks. Week 1: run 2 low-risk probes (cache TTL per-route + trace header). Week 2: collect telemetry, synthesize results, and toggle next probe (prompt-template accounting). Deliverable at end of sprint: decision memo with quantified cost/latency impact and recommended next steps (ship / iterate / drop).
metrics_to_measure: Delta in token cost per route (week over week)
Fallback invocation rate and fallback-induced latency delta
Embedding refresh ingestion time and cost per 1M vectors
Autoscale incidents (count) during synthetic spike tests
risk_flags: KV cache sharding complexity: per-route TTL could increase memory fragmentation and requires migration plan.
Observability noise: adding trace headers will increase metadata size; must keep telemetry sampling to avoid bill shock.
Embeddings partial-upsert semantics are tricky for third-party vector stores — need schema and consistency contract.
Autoscale headroom control risks underprovisioning if customers misconfigure slider — provide safe defaults.
Batch endpoints with cost caps may change developer experience (retries/backoff patterns) — need client guidance.
next_steps: Action: Engineering (Marco) to spin up per-route cache metric export to CloudWatch/Grafana for two pilot routes by 2027-04-06.
Action: Product (Ayesha) to draft trace-header format and console UX mock for fallback transparency by 2027-04-05.
Action: CS (Leah) to recruit two customers for probes and coordinate test windows (Client A, Client B) by 2027-04-03.
Action: SRE (Dmitri) to run synthetic spike tests with current autoscale settings and capture baseline by 2027-04-08.
Deliverable: Sprint decision memo due 2027-04-15 with go/no-go recommendations for each probe.
